case_scope: European Union media pluralism and agenda-power stress screen

democratic_nondomination_gate.note: The EMFA is a real current-law anchor, but Gate 12 remains watch until Member State enforcement, ownership transparency, editorial independence, state-advertising allocation, and concentration remedies are visible.

media_ownership_transparency.note: Ownership disclosure and beneficial-control visibility must be operational by outlet/platform/market, not merely named in legal text.

media_market_plurality.note: The Media Pluralism Monitor is research/context and must be paired with competition, ownership, local-news, public-media, and platform-distribution data.

sponsored_expertise_and_think_tank_trans.note: Agenda-power scoring still needs funding and sponsorship data for expertise networks, trade associations, think tanks, and policy shops.

state_advertising_or_public_media_indepe.note: State advertising, public-service media governance, surveillance/protection of journalists, and editorial independence must be monitored as conversion tests.

gate_12_democratic_non_domination.why: Gate 12 remains watch: EMFA is a substantive repair, but ownership/control, state advertising, public-media independence, platform distribution, and remedy conversion are still proof burdens.
